title.narrative: Conservation of high-value biodiversity areas in Sierra Leone - Loma Mountains National Park and Tingi Hills

description.narrative:
Direct grant to National Protected Area Authority (NPAA) in consortium with the Loma Conservation Community Programme (LCCP).

Overall objective: To contribute to the conservation of the environment and sustainable use of natural resources in Sierra Leone.

The project has three pillars: the improvement of management in protected natural areas; the promotion of alternative livelihood activities for the edge-forest communities of the protected areas; and the support to the local authorities in the delivery of services to the edge-forest communities through a Chiefdom Environment Development Fund.

The intervention will improve the governance and management of the targeted landscape, with immediate impact on the gazetted areas, through a strong partnership between the rural communities, the local and national authorities and the civil society organizations.

Main activities are the review and update of the boundaries in the protected areas, as well as their Management and Business Plans; the biomonitoring and inventory of biodiversity; the update or creation of Chiefdom Development and Land use Plans for the neighboring areas; the fostering of alternative revenue generating activities and, the provision of local infrastructure and services.
